abstract: Gemcitabine remains the standard chemotherapeutic agent for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC); however, its efficacy is limited by poor tumor targeting and low permeability caused by the dense fibrotic stroma. To overcome these limitations, we developed an integrated dual-axis combinatorial strategy. We first constructed biomimetic cancer cell membrane-coated gemcitabine nanoparticles (CMG) and co-administered them with the vitamin D analogue calcipotriol (CAL). Both in vitro and in vivo studies demonstrated that PDAC cells preferentially internalized CMG via clathrin-mediated endocytosis, and CMG can enable sustained intratumoral drug release. Simultaneously, CAL activated the vitamin D receptor signaling pathway in cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), modulatied the expression of fibrosis-related markers, and promoted CAFs to normal fibroblast then potentially enhancing nanoparticle penetration and therapeutic potential. Furthermore, mRNA sequencing, network pharmacology, and bioinformatic analyses comparing wild-type and gemcitabine-resistant PDAC cell lines identified the potential regulatory molecules implicated in CAL-improved chemoresistance, which were validated by structural dynamics and functional assays. In vivo, the CMG/CAL combined therapy significantly inhibited tumor growth while enhancing therapeutic efficiency. This integrated treatment approach rationally couples improved drug delivery with stromal remodeling, offering a promising avenue to overcome chemoresistance in PDAC.
key_points_ko: 암세포막으로 코팅된 젬시타빈 나노입자(CMG)와 칼시포트리올(CAL)의 병용 치료가 종양 성장을 유의하게 억제했습니다.
칼시포트리올(CAL)은 암 관련 섬유아세포(CAFs)를 조절하여 나노입자의 침투와 치료 잠재력을 향상시켰습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC)에서 촘촘한 섬유성 기질로 인한 젬시타빈(gemcitabine)의 약물 전달 한계를 극복하기 위해 진행되었습니다. 암세포막으로 코팅된 젬시타빈 나노입자(CMG)와 비타민 D 유사체인 칼시포트리올(CAL)을 병용 투여하는 전략을 시험했습니다. 실험 결과, CMG와 CAL의 병용 치료는 종양 성장을 유의하게 억제하고 치료 효율을 향상시켰습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않음
title: Calcipotriol-induced stromal remodeling enhances cell membrane-camouflaged gemcitabine delivery and efficacy in pancreatic cancer
title_ko: 칼시포트리올 유도 기질 리모델링을 통한 세포막 위장 젬시타빈 전달 및 췌장암 치료 효과
